sources.title: Lewanika
sources.note: Reign 1878-1884 and 1885-1916 only; no extent or tributaries

notes: Cliopatria has no Lozi row. Two pages: Barotseland (area, concessions, Order of 1899, losses of 1905 and 1911, the 1911 merger) and Lozi people (Makololo date 'about 1830'; reign of Lewanika). The 'Barotseland Protectorate' as a named entity is not on the pages. Year conflicts recorded: Makololo conquest (1830, c. 1840, 1838 settling at Victoria Falls, by 1845), Lawley concession (1898 on the page, 1900 elsewhere), Portuguese occupation 1895 vs. 1905 loss. The Western Province of Zambia and the 352 km Mongu disc are stand-ins; the Kwito and Kafue limits are not drawn. Counterparts: makololo-kingdom (this batch), british-south-africa-company (no dossier; also Ndebele), portuguese-angola and german-africa and british-africa (Cliopatria). Gazetteer names needed: Bulozi / Barotseland (region), Lealui, Limulunga, Kwito (river). REPAIR 2026-10-19 (after review): (1) K0 split into lozi-kingdom_1650 (1650-1839) and lozi-kingdom_1864 (1864-1877), so the Western Province is not drawn by both Lozi and Makololo in 1840-1863. (2) The Caprivi overlap with Cliopatria's german-africa (reported from 1890; the page gives only the 1911 loss) is stated in the notes of lozi-kingdom_1878, _1899 and _1905 for the af-08 group. (3) The 1895 Portuguese occupation of the western territory is typed (occupation_start 1895, occupation_end 1905, portuguese-angola). (4) Thin items tried: Lozi people (no founding year), Lewanika (no 1878 extent), Barotseland (1895 sentence confirmed; no 1890-1910 German period on the page).
